question: What evidence is sufficient to reserve or decline the `@ifabrish-skills` / `@ifabrish` namespace request for this claimant?
rationale: Code provides the intake form and admin reservation tools, but only staff can verify real-world ownership and decide whether assigning namespace publishing trust is safe.

options.title: Request stronger proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for public-safe evidence or a private verification path before any reservation.

options.title: Reserve after private verification
options.body: If staff has already verified ownership privately, use the existing admin reservation tooling and record a public-safe disposition.

options.title: Decline if proof remains insufficient
options.body: If no ownership evidence can be provided, close the claim without changing namespace ownership.

recommendation.title: Request stronger proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for public-safe evidence or a private verification path before any reservation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects namespace and package publishing trust, and CODEOWNERS routes these security-sensitive docs and backend surfaces to this team.
